content:
Evidence from the datasheet: the **System performance** table defines two distinct operating conditions (same 10.709 Gb/s test rate); everything else in the multi-value pool is module-wide (DWDM 50 GHz C-band, multirate 9.95–11.35 Gb/s, shared interface/protocol lists) and is not split into separate rows. Per your rule, amplified (**Noise loaded**) and **Unamplified links** are separate modes. `10.709 Gb/s` maps to `11.1` in the pool; receiver note 2 (`OSNR > 35 dB`, `BER 1×10⁻¹²`) matches the unamplified row.

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "Noise loaded link",
      "wavelength_band": "DWDM",
      "channel_spacing_ghz": 50.0,
      "host_interface_name": "10GBASE-ER",
      "standards_code": "OTU2e",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 11.1,
      "rx_osnr_db": 19.0,
      "cd_tolerance_ps_nm": 1500.0,
      "post_fec_ber_target": 0.0001
    },
    {
      "label": "Unamplified link",
      "wavelength_band": "DWDM",
      "channel_spacing_ghz": 50.0,
      "host_interface_name": "10GBASE-ER",
      "standards_code": "OTU2e",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 11.1,
      "rx_osnr_db": 35.0,
      "cd_tolerance_ps_nm": 1600.0,
      "post_fec_ber_target": 1e-12
    }
  ]
}
```
